reads.name: Rocco Arena, b. 20 December 1861
reads.father: Francesco Antonio Arena, 42, marinaro, son of Filippo
reads.note: Declared 23 December 1861 at Scilla, Distretto di Reggio, by the father. Witnesses Giuseppe Idone, 64, and Francesco Antonio Poli, 70, proprietario; parish note records the baptism on the 23rd. Gives THREE generations: Filippo Arena, his son Francesco Antonio (b. c.1819), and Rocco. CONFLICTS WITH THE TREE, which makes Rocco the son of Orazio Arena and Giovana Zirilli. The 1861 register holds only one Rocco Arena.

reads.name: Giovanni Polistena, b. 16 September 1883
reads.note: Born at half past nine in the evening at Via Grotte 47, Scilla; declared next morning by the father before Minasi Raffaele, assessore. The father's name AGREES with the tree's "Antonio Polistena" and dates him to about 1835. The mother does NOT: the register says Giovanna ROMANO, the tree says Giovanna PONTILLO. The tree also gives that Giovanna Pontillo two parents both surnamed Pontillo, which looks like an error in the tree rather than a second marriage.

reads.name: Arena Domenica
reads.note: Another Arena birth at Scilla in 1861, not in the family tree. Parentage not read.

correction.what: This archive read the 1861 index as giving Rocco Arena's parents as «Giuseppe e Zirilli Grazia». The act says Francesco Antonio Arena and Serafina Arlotta. The index's parents column had been misaligned by one row.
correction.why: The Scilla index is a wide ruled table photographed across a gutter, and once the columns are cropped apart the row a name sits on is not reliably the row its parents sit on.
correction.lesson: It was recorded as a CANDIDATE, not a join, precisely because the forenames did not match the family tree — and that caution is what caught it.

sea.prostamo: Alfonso and Domenico Prostamo, Briatico 1886 — MARINARI
sea.point: Three families, two provinces, and every man the registers name works the sea. The family tree records none of them as anything.
